summary: The positive GIFT Nifty signal faded at the open: the Nifty slipped back just under 23,000 and the Sensex was down about 190 points as autos and financials weighed.

detail.leaders: Not yet reported in early trade
detail.laggards: Auto and financial stocks, YES Bank
detail.tone: Weaker than the pre-open signal: GIFT Nifty had pointed 75–95 points higher, but by 9:18 am the Sensex was down about 190 points at roughly 74,126.
